content:
The book "Circular Economy Design and Management in the Built Environment – A Critical Review of the State of the Art" has been published, compiling the most recent work carried out under the Cost action "Circular B", and featuring articles co-authored by Vanessa Tavares, Head of Sustainability at BUILT CoLAB.

In this open-access publication, articles co-authored by Vanessa Tavares can be accessed in the following chapters:

Chapter 1 – "Circular Economy Best Practices in the Built Environment"

Chapter 6 – "Design Frameworks for Circular Buildings: Circular Principles, Building Lifecycle Phases and Design Strategies"

Chapter 8 – "Modularity and Prefabrication"

Chapter 13 – "Circularity Criteria and Indicators at the Building Component and System Level"

Chapter 17 – "Driving the Built Environment Twin Transition: Synergising Circular Economy and Digital Tools"

You can view the full book here.

As a reminder, a COST action is an interdisciplinary research network that brings together researchers and innovators to investigate a topic of their choice over 4 years. COST actions are typically made up of researchers from academia, SMEs, public institutions and other relevant organisations or stakeholders.
